messages:
linda_salesops: Hey team, Stratus sent over an RFI this morning asking for: integration options (VPC peering vs. VPN), on-prem connector details, expected latency for a 2k token chat workload, and a POC cost breakdown. They attached a compliance checklist and want a capability matrix by EOD Friday. Can we coordinate?
anna_sales: Thanks Linda. Quick Q — they want an example SLA for Dedicated vs Hosted. Do we have a one-pager? :eyes:
michael_se: I can put together the tech answers. Need to confirm whether they need HSM-backed keys for model encryption or just KMIP/KMS. Linda, does the RFI say FedRAMP/IL?
linda_salesops: No FedRAMP requested, but they mention SOC2 type 2 and customer-managed keys. HSM would be nice to call out as optional.
tina_security: We should flag that Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) on Private require KMS integration with our Private control plane. HSM (BYOK via HSM) is supported in Dedicated through our partner integration — need legal sign-off for key custody language. I'll draft the security blurb.
oliver_engineer: For the latency bit — our 80th/95th percentiles on a 2k token chat (gpt-like transformer) on Dedicated A100 pool: 80th ~120ms per token, 95th ~300ms per token under steady 100 qps with batching. For Hosted small instances (shared), expect ~200-350ms per token. These are rough; I can export runbook logs.
raj_sre: Note that those numbers are with KV cache warm + continuous batching. Cold cache first token adds ~400-800ms. Also network egress to customer VPC via peering adds ~10-30ms depending on region.
anna_sales: Great — can you paste the commands or config snippet we can give them for VPC peering + sample LB config? Stratus asked for IaC examples.
oliver_engineer: Sure — sample snippet (Terraform):
```
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "peer" {
  provider = "redwood"
  account_id = "<account-id>"
  vpc_id = "vpc-abc123"
  region = "us-west-2"
}
```
Also include our wiring doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/vpc-peering (internal).
michael_se: For the POC cost breakdown, propose 2-week Dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) + 10k tokens/day usage for eval + monitoring support. Ballpark: $18k/week for reserved capacity + $0.02/1k tokens on top. I'll make a table.
linda_salesops: Stratus requested a capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Can we map features: infra isolation, CMKs, SLA, typical latency, cost model, integration effort?
anna_sales: I'll assemble the matrix from our standard template. Call out that Private supports on-prem airgap deployments but requires a minimum 3-mo eng engagement.
tina_security: Security Q&A — a few specific items from their checklist:
- Do we support customer HSM for key generation? -> Yes (Dedicated & Private via partner/HSM integrations).
- Can we provide audit logs for model access at token level? -> We provide request-level logs and token-level cost breakdown, but we don't log raw prompt text by default unless customer enables logging.
- Data residency guarantees? -> For Dedicated/Private we can pin region; Hosted is region-selected but not strict residency guarantee unless contractually agreed.
I'll draft precise language.
deploy-bot: Attachment uploaded: stratus_rfi_2026-03-21/stratus_compliance_checklist.pdf
anna_sales: Thanks bot. Linda — timeline? They want a response Friday EOD, today is Tuesday. That gives us 3 business days.
linda_salesops: Yes. Can everyone add their sections by Thursday noon? Sales will review Thursday afternoon and send final.
michael_se: I'll add the technical appendix (benchmarks, config, model variants + quantization notes) by tomorrow afternoon.
oliver_engineer: I'll export the runbook logs and a short benchmark CSV. ETA tomorrow 11:00 PT.
raj_sre: I'll write the ops checklist for peering/VPC and note service limits (max connections, idle timeout) — will include failover guidance.
tina_security: I'll attach the security writeup and a sanitized screenshot of our audit log UI.
anna_sales: I'll draft pricing options: pay-as-you-go hosted, 3-mo reserved, and 12-mo committed for Dedicated with tiered discounts. Also propose add-on: 24/7 onboarding support for POC ($5k).
linda_salesops: Perfect. One more: Stratus asked whether we can support model pinning during POC (freeze model version). Answer: yes for Dedicated and Private; Hosted we can allocate a model variant and control rollouts. Include rollback policy.
michael_se: Note about fallback: we can set automated fallback policies to a smaller model for latency-critical endpoints — mention in capability matrix.
anna_sales: Ok I'm updating the matrix now. I'll ping when draft ready for review. :thumbsup:
linda_salesops: Thanks team — let's keep replies short in the thread so we can assemble. I'll upload the first draft matrix as soon as Anna posts the pricing.
michael_se: One ask from Stratus: sample SLA wording for 99.5% uptime and credits. Legal needs to review but we have precedent; I'll pull the clause from previous Dedicated deals.
linda_salesops: Excellent. Tag me when drafts are uploaded.
anna_sales: Uploaded: stratus_capability_matrix_draft.xlsx and pricing_options.md (links in DM). Please review.
oliver_engineer: Reviewing now. Found a small clarity item on quantization — will comment directly in the sheet.
raj_sre: Added peering runbook items.
tina_security: Uploaded security_rfi_answers.md.
linda_salesops: Review complete — minor edits. Will package and send to Stratus Friday morning unless objections.
anna_sales: No objections. Ready to go.
linda_salesops: Sending to Stratus Friday 09:00 PT. Thanks all! :rocket!
